'''New Republic soldiers''' (also known as '''New Republic troopers''') were standard foot soldiers of the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]]. They were the successors to the [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] and were eventually converted into the [[Galactic Alliance Infantry Trooper]]s.

==History==
The New Republic troopers replaced the [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] in the months following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the formation of the New Republic. They were better trained and better equipped than they were during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Rebellion]].<ref name="SWMU">{{SWMiniCite|set=Universe|pack=New Republic Trooper}}</ref>

[[File:NRTroops.jpg|thumb|left|200px|New Republic troopers on [[Rychel]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]]]
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], they wore a white body armor similar to the [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]] worn by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]; however, this armor did not cover the entire body. Underneath they wore light blue uniforms. Their helmets had orange tinted transparent visors that could seal the helmet. On the rear of the body armor was a tank connected to the helmet. They were armed with blaster rifles and pistols. These troops saw action during the [[Battle of Dantooine (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Dantooine]], [[Battle of Artorias]], the [[Evacuation of Rychel]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and the [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (29 ABY)|Battle of Yag'Dhul]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], along with hundreds of other battles during the war.

==Weapons and Equipment==
[[File:RepublicTroops10ABYonAltyrV.jpg|thumb|right|New Republic troopers on [[Altyr V base|Altyr V]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], New Republic troopers were armed and equipped the same as their forerunner Rebel troopers. Their primary weapon was either the [[DH-17 blaster rifle/Legends|DH-17 blaster rifle]] or the [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280C blaster rifle]], their backup weapon was either a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]] or a [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]]. In later years, notably the Yuuzhan Vong War, New Republic troopers wore armor similar to the Imperial stormtrooper and wielded [[E-15A blaster rifle]]s.
